question: The ________ Health Card Scheme was launched by the Government of India in the year 2014-15.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Soil**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Soil Health Card Scheme** was launched by the Government of India in the year **2014-15**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide **soil health cards** to farmers, which contain information on the nutrient status of their soil and recommendations on the appropriate dosage of nutrients for improving soil health and fertility.
 
• By providing this information, the scheme helps farmers to make informed decisions about their soil management practices, thereby enhancing agricultural productivity and sustainability.
 
• The initiative is part of the broader effort to promote sustainable agriculture and ensure food security in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Soil Health Card Scheme is implemented by the** Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers' Welfare** under the **Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare**.
 
• Under this scheme, soil samples are collected from individual farms and tested in various soil testing labs across the country.
 
• The scheme also aims to create awareness among farmers about the importance of soil health and the techniques to improve it.
 
• Periodic monitoring and evaluation are conducted to ensure the effectiveness of the scheme and to make necessary improvements.
